help.stdout:
Usage: web-listening [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                                                       
                                                                                                                        
 Web Listening - monitor websites for changes                                                                           
                                                                                                                        
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --install-completion          Install completion for the current shell.                                              │
│ --show-completion             Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize the installation.       │
│ --help                        Show this message and exit.                                                            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ validate-access-contract       Validate and inspect one access contract offline.                                     │
│ validate-acquisition-contract  Validate a producer-confirmed acquisition contract bundle offline.                    │
│ diagnose-site                  Probe robots.txt first and produce bounded sitemap planning evidence.                 │
│ list-site-skills               List valid and invalid filesystem Site Skill candidates.                              │
│ inspect-site-skill             Inspect one exactly selected Site Skill package.                                      │
│ validate-site-skill            Statically validate a package path or one exact registry selection.                   │
│ add-site                       Add a website to monitor.                                                             │
│ list-sites                     List all monitored sites.                                                             │
│ check                          Legacy target checking is disabled; use governed run-scope.                           │
│ list-changes                   Show recorded changes.                                                                │
│ download-docs                  Legacy direct download is disabled; use governed scoped execution.                    │
│ list-docs                      List downloaded documents.                                                            │
│ analyze                        Run AI analysis on recent changes.                                                    │
│ list-acquisition-tools         List acquisition tool contracts and probe capabilities.                               │
│ build-acquisition-profile      Build a default acquisition profile control artifact.                                 │
│ inspect-browseract             Inspect an optional BrowserAct CLI without browser interaction or writes.             │
│ fetch-article-content          Fetch article content and emit its JSON evidence envelope.                            │
│ probe-acquisition              Inspect candidate adapter evidence; direct target reads are disabled.                 │
│ preview-execution-plan         Compile a read-only acquisition execution preview without probing runtimes.           │
│ serve                          Start the FastAPI server.                                                             │
│ discover                       Discover staged workflow site sections and write inventory artifacts.                 │
│ classify                       Classify discovered sections and write classification artifacts.                      │
│ select                         Inspect a reviewed selection artifact and expose the chosen path clearly.             │
│ plan-scope                     Compile a reviewed selection into a monitor scope artifact.                           │
│ bootstrap-scope                Bootstrap a stored monitor scope into the tracking database.                          │
│ run-scope                      Run an initialized monitor scope incrementally.                                       │
│ report-scope                   Export a tracking report for one monitor scope.                                       │
│ aggregate-batch-result         Aggregate terminal site results offline, without opening Storage.                     │
│ export-manifest                Export scope document manifest artifacts.                                             │
│ list-jobs                      List persisted staged-workflow jobs.                                                  │
│ get-job                        Show one persisted staged-workflow job and its artifact contract.                     │
│ create-monitor-task            Create a first-class monitor task artifact for agent/human workflows.                 │
│ export-tracking-report         Export a unified tracking report from a scope run and optional task artifact.         │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
